'''PA-LT4''' was a [[Color|white]] and gold plated<ref name="Extraordinary Droids" /> [[A-LT Utility Droid]] that was owned by the criminal [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="SoloDate">{{FilmDate|Solo}}</ref> it<ref name="Extraordinary Droids" /> was one of a team of [[Service droid|droids]] serving [[Foodstuff|food]] in the lounge of the ''[[First Light]]'', a [[yacht]] owned by Crimson Dawn's leader [[Dryden Vos]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> As the vessel landed on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]],<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> PA-LT4 had a fresh [[fruit]] assortment in the temperature-controlled serving tray atop its body and did its best to remain inconspicuous and not get underfoot. The [[droid]] was equipped with two precision engineered traction treads.<ref name="SoloOG" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
PA-LT4 first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
